# ProfileOutput

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Other](Language-Features-Other)

</div>


```blitzbasic
ProfileOutput:Void file:String
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | In | String | required | The file that receives the text, or an empty string for the standard error output. |

## Description

Sends what the profiling prints to a file instead of the standard error output: the report of [ProfileFPS](ProfileFPS) and the lines of [ProfileSlow](ProfileSlow). It does the same as the environment variable `BLITZLLVM_PROFILE_OUTPUT`, which only decides how the program starts. The file is created new (an existing file is overwritten) and every line is written out at once, so it can be read while the program runs. An empty name closes the file and goes back to the standard error output. If the file can not be opened, a warning is printed and the standard error output is used. Without `--profile` (or `-d`) this command does nothing.

## Differences

* This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 64, 64, 0, 2
ProfileOutput "profile.txt"
ProfileFPS 1
; ... run the part of the program that is measured ...
ProfileFPS 0
ProfileOutput ""
```
